title: After I explicitly sealed the Vale of Ash barrow doors ('You draw the great doors shut from within the passage and hear the seal-stone drop... True to your word', and Barrow Field itself later read 'The doors are sealed, as you left them'), the smith at The Forge said on my return: 'Word beat you back to the square — the barrow stands open.' Direct factual contradiction of a choice the game itself had just confirmed twice.
where: The Forge / talk to smith -> 'the open barrow doors'
